phrase.zh: 冷到一定程度，电流换一种走法。
phrase.en: Below a threshold, current behaves differently.

visual.zh: 低温装置、悬浮圆环和发亮的路径交织，表现超导与磁场的关系。悬浮姿态是艺术画面，不构成可复现的实验方案。
visual.en: Cold apparatus, a floating ring and luminous paths evoke superconductivity and magnetic fields. The levitation is artistic, not a reproducible experiment.

background.zh: 某些材料冷却到临界温度以下后，直流电可以在没有电阻损耗的状态下流动，同时材料会排斥磁场。超导还受温度、电流和磁场限制，不能理解成普通环境中的“无限能源”。
background.en: Below a critical temperature, certain materials conduct direct current without resistive loss and expel magnetic fields. Superconductivity also has temperature, current and field limits; it is not an unlimited energy source at ordinary conditions.
